title: Week's best: Shark Stratos £199, a Philips dual air fryer £89.99 and the Glossybox advent calendar £85
description: The strongest UK deals we could re-check this week: Currys' early Black Friday cuts, AirPods 5 at £119 and two beauty advent calendars.
intro:
**This week's biggest story is Currys starting its Black Friday sale a month early, with a price guarantee.** Buy at Currys before 24 November, register the purchase, and if Currys cuts the price again before 1 December you can claim the difference. That makes its early prices safer than most, so five of this week's best picks come from that sale.

The standouts: the Shark Stratos cordless at £199 (less than half its original price), the Philips 3000 Series dual-basket air fryer at £89.99 and the Bosch Unlimited 7 at £229. For gifts, the Glossybox 2026 advent calendar is £85 and AirPods 5 are £119. Currys prices are as reported on 29 October; the others were checked on retailer pages on 30 October.

deals.name: Shark Stratos Cordless Vacuum with Anti Hair Wrap Plus (IZ411UKT)
deals.note: Shark's flagship cordless for pet homes, at well under half its launch price. Register it with the Currys guarantee in case it drops further. More in our [Shark Black Friday guide](/guides/shark-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Philips 3000 Series Dual Basket Air Fryer (NA35319)
deals.note: Two baskets for cooking a main and a side together, for under £90. A cheaper alternative to the big-name dual drawers if you don't need the extra capacity.

deals.name: Ninja 6-in-1 DualZone XL Air Fryer (DZ901UK)
deals.note: The larger Ninja dual drawer, which suits families cooking for four or more. Fair now, but it has gone lower in past sales. See our [air fryer Black Friday guide](/guides/air-fryer-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Bosch Unlimited 7 Cordless Vacuum (BCS712LGB)
deals.note: A well-made cordless with a swappable battery, at £170 off. Worth a look if you want a Dyson rival without the Dyson price.

deals.name: Sage the Barista Express Bean-to-Cup Espresso Machine (BES875)
deals.note: The all-in-one espresso machine with a built-in grinder. £130 off is a solid early price, and the Currys guarantee covers you if it falls again.

deals.name: GLOSSYBOX 2026 Advent Calendar (26 products, worth over £645)
deals.note: 26 products for £85, and in stock when we checked. Subscribers pay £75. Compare it with the rest in our [beauty advent calendars guide](/guides/beauty-advent-calendars-2026/).

deals.name: LOOKFANTASTIC Beauty Advent Calendar 2026 (worth over £665)
deals.note: 25 doors with 19 full-size products, for about half the price of the Cult Beauty calendar. Our new [Cult Beauty advent calendar guide](/guides/cult-beauty-advent-calendar-2026/) compares the two.

deals.name: Apple AirPods 5
deals.note: Noise cancelling now comes as standard, which makes these better value than the older AirPods 4 with ANC at £129. Same price at John Lewis. See our [AirPods Black Friday guide](/guides/airpods-black-friday-deals-2026/).

body:
## Worth waiting for?

At Currys, no: the price guarantee means buying now costs you nothing if you register the purchase and Currys cuts the price before 1 December. Elsewhere, big-ticket tech like the Dyson V15 and AirPods Pro 3 usually drops further in Black Friday week, so hold off on those. Advent calendars are the exception: the popular ones can sell out before December, so if you've found one you want at a fair price, buying now is reasonable. Check retailer start dates in [when is Black Friday 2026](/guides/when-is-black-friday-2026-uk/), and every brand guide is on the [Black Friday hub](/black-friday/).

## Earlier this week

We couldn't re-check this week's electric blanket, heated throw and airer prices today, so they're not repeated here. Monday's [keep warm for less spotlight](/spotlight/keep-warm-for-less-winter-2026/) has the full comparison and the target prices to look for.

## New and updated guides

We've published a new [Cult Beauty advent calendar 2026 guide](/guides/cult-beauty-advent-calendar-2026/) and refreshed the [AirPods](/guides/airpods-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [Nintendo Switch 2](/guides/nintendo-switch-2-black-friday-deals-2026/) Black Friday guides with today's prices.
